convoLines.text: DeAndre: "I've been thinking. You and me — we should be bonded. Not just neighbors. Will you stick with me?"
"Stick together, then." They look steadier already.
"Do you still count the days? I lost track days ago. I mean it."
"Why do you ask? Good. Keep counting. The days need witnesses."
"All right. Thank you for asking."
Something eases in their shoulders. They're really talking to you now.
"Still on what day it is."
"Sorry — I shouldn't load that on you. What's up?"
"Good question." "The whole fire was arguing about Night Court last night — what to even CALL it. 'Old Gavel' got shouted down. What's your vote?"
"Alright — I should get back to it."
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"You look handy. What did you do with your hands, before?"
"Useful. Everything useful matters now. I mean that as a compliment."
"These hands? Community gardener hands. Clipboards, mostly. Now they hold wire and wood, and they learn fast. Hands are honest that way."
"...What's that supposed to mean?" Their voice goes careful.
"Still on what you did with your hands."
"Out there? With YOU leading? ...Let me think about it."
"Look, forget it. You wanted something?"
A flicker at the corner of their mouth. Not quite a smile. Not quite anything.
"Okay." Sofia looks down. "Okay. It was me. 1× Stone — I was hungry and I... I'm sorry." Their voice is small.
They fill the quiet. "Anyway — where was I?"
"Sure. I'll be around."
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
"Never mind the food I needed — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"...Never mind me. What were you going to say?"
"Have you heard what they're calling Night Court? DeAndre is pushing 'Judge Hoot'. Everyone's got a name for it and nobody agrees."
"I see." They take a moment to think about your answer.
Their voice loosens. The guardedness thins.
"I have opinions about the name. I am saving them for when they count."
"Give it three more days of arguing. Then someone says the obvious thing and we all pretend it was theirs."
"Still on what's been happening."
You show them Black Walnut — where it grows, how to tell it apart. A short laugh. "And I've been walking past it for weeks."
You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.
"I should go before I say something sincere."
"This was good." They mean it.
"We never finished talking about what's been happening — we left it mid-thought, 4 days back. 'Alright — I should get back to it.'"
"This one is American Persimmon. Look at the leaf, feel the stem, breathe it in. It'll stick."
"an old trapline — I'll show you on the map sometime. It's real."
"I'm staying out of the naming fight. For now. Someone always gets precious about their pick."
"A name. Okay." You say it out loud, trying the shape of it:
🤝 "The Company." It hangs in the air a moment — then DeAndre grins. It's real now. It has a name, which means it can be lost.
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
🤝 DeAndre is 👁️ Scout now. Sees trouble first. Warns the party on the road.
"The fire'll settle it. It settles everything, eventually."
"Still on what's been happening."
Something in them almost softens — then doesn't. Not yet.
You show them Elderberry — where it grows, how to tell it apart. They nod slowly, committing it to memory. "Good to know. Really good to know."
"Yeah? What's up? Funny how that works."
"Oh — okay. Later, then."
"This was good." They mean it.
"Can I tell you something? At night I talk to someone who isn't there anymore."
Grace has an edge today — something curdled.
"I needed someone to know — just one person. Thank you for being that person."
"Got a read on anyone here yet? Who should I be watching?"
A warmth settles over the conversation — they lean in a little.
"Still on that question."
"Alright. But I'm not carrying your stuff."
"Forget I said anything. What did you want?"
"Good question." "The whole fire was arguing about Static last night — what to even CALL it. 'Don't-Look' got shouted down. What's your vote?"
"Take your time."
"Names are for when it's dead or known. Right now it's neither, so I do push-ups at dawn instead."
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
DeAndre nods, stepping back. "Scout is yours now." (Roles are promises. There's only one of each.)
"We'll land on something. We always do — usually the loudest person's idea."
"Oh — okay. Later, then."
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
"This was good." They mean it.
"We never finished talking about what's been happening — we got cut off, 7 days back. 'Yeah? What's up? Funny how that works.'"
"Masoor Lentil — crush the leaf, smell it, taste the stem. That's how you know it."
"I listen to everyone and nod. It's a strategy. Probably."
They nod slowly, not quite done, not quite continuing.
"what's been happening — that's still where we are."
"Did you sleep? I kept hearing things out past the treeline."
They go still. "So it's not just me. Good. That's... good to know. Bad, but good."
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
Grace nods, stepping back. "Scout is yours now." (Roles are promises. There's only one of each.)
"Sure — what's on your mind? Can't sit still, you know?"
"Huh. Let me think about that." "I'd follow you out past the treeline. Don't tell the others — they'd want to come too."
"Right. Go on, then."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"About that question — Did you leave someone behind? ...Sorry. You don't have to answer that."
Just: "Yeah." A long quiet. "Me too."
Their friendliness thins — still there, just held at arm's length.
"Practical view: Still on who you left behind."
"...Never mind me. What were you going to say?"

"You want to know about that? Okay." "Last time things were different. They always are." "Have you heard what they're calling Hushpuppy? DeAndre is pushing 'Big Big'. Everyone's got a name for it and nobody agrees."
They nod. "Okay."
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
"That's... pretty much all of it, honestly."
DeAndre nods, stepping back. "Scout is yours now." (Roles are promises. There's only one of each.)
You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.
"Anyway." A small smile.
You show them Goldenrod — where it grows, how to tell it apart. They nod slowly, committing it to memory. "Good to know. Really good to know."
"Right. Go on, then."
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."

lines: d6: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d6: 🕯️ Heinrich Stepanov is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d6: What Heinrich kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d6: Ruby picks up the journal. Their hands shake. Then they open it, and keep writing.

d6: 📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
d6: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d6: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
d6: 📖 LEARNED: Mediation (Level 1). Let each side talk without interruption. Repeat back what you heard. People de-escalate when heard.
d6: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d6: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Heinrich Stepanov, 6 days. The mantle passes to Ruby Pang.
d6: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Ruby Pang, 35 — an interpreter. Their hands know different work now: Iron Stomach.
d6: The fire knew Ruby — solid ground, earned at this fire.

lastSay: d31: 💬 Ruth says: "They said you're doing well. It sounded... proud? Can they feel proud?"
d31: You wake with a start — something is wrong.
d31: 📦 A care package drops from the sky with a little parachute. There's a note: "WE LOVE YOU!"
d31: Plus 35 kcal of fan-approved snacks.
